query:
SELECT c.id, c.cardNumber, c.characterName, c.cardType, c.imageUrl, c.backImageUrl 
FROM cards c 
JOIN card_sets cs ON c.setId = cs.id 
WHERE cs.slug = '2025-topps-comic-book-heroes' 
ORDER BY CAST(c.cardNumber AS UNSIGNED) 
LIMIT 30;
